glosses.en: to say / to utter / to declare; to say

sentences.target: 私は本当のことを言います。
sentences.reading: わたくしはほんとうのことを言います。

tokens.explanation: Refers to the speaker as the topic of the sentence.
Marks '私' as the topic of the sentence.
Describes the authenticity of the following noun 'こと'.
Links '本当' to 'こと' in a possessive/genitive relationship.
Refers to the abstract matter or fact being discussed.
Marks '本当のこと' as the direct object of '言います'.
Polite non-past form of '言う', meaning to express or say something.

sentences.reading: かのじょはひみつをいった。

translations.vi: Cô ấy đã nói bí mật.

tokens.explanation: Third-person female pronoun referring to the subject.
Marks '彼女' as the topic of the sentence.
Denotes the information that was kept hidden.
Marks '秘密' as the direct object of '言った'.
Past plain form of '言う', indicating the action of speaking occurred.

sentences.target: 本当の気持ちを言えない..。
sentences.reading: ほんとうのきもちをいえない..。

translations.en: I can't say my true feelings...
translations.es: No puedo decir mis verdaderos sentimientos...
translations.fr: Je ne peux pas dire mes vrais sentiments...
translations.de: Ich kann nicht sagen, was ich wirklich empfinde...
translations.it: Non posso dire i miei veri sentimenti...
translations.zh-Hans: 我不能说出我的真实感受......
translations.yue: 我不能說出我的真實感受......
translations.ru: Я не могу выразить свои истинные чувства...
translations.pt: Não posso dizer meus verdadeiros sentimentos...
translations.he: אני לא יכול לומר את הרגשות האמיתיים שלי...
translations.vi: Tôi không thể nói ra cảm xúc thật của mình...
translations.ar: لا أستطيع أن أقول مشاعري الحقيقية ...
translations.nl: Ik kan mijn ware gevoelens niet zeggen...
translations.uk: Я не можу передати свої справжні відчуття...
translations.hu: Nem tudom elmondani az igazi érzéseimet...
translations.hi: मैं अपनी सच्ची भावनाओं को व्यक्त नहीं कर सकता ...
translations.pl: Nie potrafię powiedzieć, co naprawdę czuję...
translations.el: Δεν μπορώ να πω τα αληθινά μου συναισθήματα...
translations.nb: Jeg kan ikke si mine sanne følelser ...
translations.id: Saya tidak bisa mengatakan perasaan saya yang sebenarnya...
translations.sv: Jag kan inte säga mina sanna känslor...
translations.ro: Nu pot spune adevăratele mele sentimente...
translations.da: Jeg kan ikke sige mine sande følelser...

tokens.explanation: Qualifies the nature of '気持ち' as genuine.
Links '本当' to '気持ち' in a genitive relationship.
Refers to emotional state or sentiment.
Marks '本当の気持ち' as the direct object of '言えない'.
Negative potential form of '言う', indicating inability to express.

sentences.reading: いまからほんねをいおう！

translations.en: Now, I'll speak my true feelings!
translations.fr: Maintenant, je vais exprimer mes vrais sentiments !
translations.de: Jetzt werde ich meine wahren Gefühle aussprechen!
translations.it: Ora, dirò i miei veri sentimenti!
translations.zh-Hans: 现在，我将说出我的真实感受！
translations.yue: 現時，我將說出我的真實感受！
translations.ru: Теперь я расскажу о своих истинных чувствах!
translations.pt: Agora, vou falar meus verdadeiros sentimentos!
translations.he: עכשיו, אני אדבר את רגשותיי האמיתיים!
translations.vi: Bây giờ, tôi sẽ nói ra cảm xúc thật của mình!
translations.nl: Nu zal ik mijn ware gevoelens uitspreken!
translations.uk: Тепер я скажу про свої справжні почуття!
translations.hu: Most pedig elmondom az igazi érzéseimet!
translations.hi: अब, मैं अपनी सच्ची भावनाओं को बोलूंगा!
translations.pl: A teraz powiem o moich prawdziwych uczuciach!
translations.el: Τώρα, θα πω τα αληθινά μου συναισθήματα!
translations.nb: Nå skal jeg si mine sanne følelser!
translations.id: Sekarang, saya akan mengungkapkan perasaan saya yang sebenarnya!
translations.sv: Nu ska jag tala om mina sanna känslor!
translations.ro: Acum, voi spune adevăratele mele sentimente!
translations.da: Nu vil jeg sige mine sande følelser!

tokens.explanation: Refers to the current moment as the starting point.
Indicates the starting point '今' for the upcoming action.
Denotes one's real intentions or honest thoughts.
Marks '本音' as the object of '言おう'.
Volitional form of '言う', expressing intent to speak honestly.

sentences.target: ねこが「にゃー」と言います。
sentences.reading: ねこが「にゃー」と言います。

tokens.explanation: The subject of the verb, indicating the animal making the sound.
Marks 'ねこ' as the subject or agent of '言います'.
Represents the sound a cat makes, used here as the quoted utterance.
Introduces the content of speech or quotation.
The main verb meaning to say or speak, describing the action performed by the subject.

sentences.target: いぬが「わんわん」と言います。
sentences.reading: いぬが「わんわん」と言います。

tokens.explanation: The subject of the verb, indicating the animal making the sound.
Marks 'いぬ' as the subject or agent of '言います'.
Represents the barking sound of a dog, used as the quoted utterance.
Introduces the content of speech or quotation.
The main verb meaning to say or speak, describing the action performed by the subject.

sentences.target: こどもが「おはよう」と言います。
sentences.reading: こどもが「おはよう」と言います。

tokens.explanation: The subject of the verb, indicating who is speaking.
Marks 'こども' as the subject or agent of '言います'.
A greeting used as the quoted utterance.
Introduces the content of speech or quotation.
The main verb meaning to say or speak, describing what the subject utters.

sentences.target: わたしは「ありがとう」と言います。
sentences.reading: わたしは「ありがとう」と言います。

tokens.explanation: First-person pronoun referring to the speaker.
Marks 'わたし' as the topic of the sentence.
An expression of gratitude used as the quoted utterance.
Introduces the content of speech or quotation.
The main verb meaning to say or speak, describing what the speaker utters.

jp: 私は本当のことを言います。
本当の気持ちを言えない..。
ねこが「にゃー」と言います。
いぬが「わんわん」と言います。
こどもが「おはよう」と言います。
わたしは「ありがとう」と言います。
fu: わたくしはほんとうのことを言います。
かのじょはひみつをいった。
ほんとうのきもちをいえない..。
いまからほんねをいおう！
ねこが「にゃー」と言います。
いぬが「わんわん」と言います。

わたしは「ありがとう」と言います。
